# Grammar conformance fixtures, v0.2 (specs/grammar.md section 8).
# Format: input || canonical InputForm || LaTeX
# New surface added in v0.2: patterns, comparisons, /@, Set/SetDelayed, Pi,
# and comments (which the lexer strips before the parser ever sees them).
# This file is additive to grammar-v0.1.txt, which stays in force unchanged.
_ || _ || \_
_Integer || _Integer || \_Integer
__ || __ || \_\_
___ || ___ || \_\_\_
x_ || x_ || x\_
x_Integer || x_Integer || x\_Integer
f[x_Integer, y_] || f[x_Integer, y_] || f\left(x\_Integer, y\_\right)
1 < 2 || 1 < 2 || 1 < 2
a > b || a > b || a > b
a <= b || a <= b || a \leq b
a >= b || a >= b || a \geq b
a != b || a != b || a \neq b
Pi || Pi || \pi
(* a comment *) 1 + 2 || 1 + 2 || 1 + 2
(* nested (* comment *) still a comment *) x || x || x
f /@ {1, 2, 3} || Map[f, {1, 2, 3}] || \operatorname{Map}\left(f, \left\{1, 2, 3\right\}\right)
a = 5 || a = 5 || a = 5
f[x_] := x^2 || f[x_] := x^2 || f\left(x\_\right) := x^{2}
If[True, 1, 2] || If[True, 1, 2] || \operatorname{If}\left(True, 1, 2\right)
